name: Tree view
description: A hierarchical list whose parent items expand and collapse, such as folders in a file browser. Use it when people need to browse and select within a hierarchy; for site navigation, nested lists of links are simpler.

elements.name: Expand icon
elements.description: Chevron or triangle beside each parent item; shows open or closed

elements.name: Child group
elements.description: Nested list with role="group", indented under its parent

elements.name: Item icon
elements.description: Folder or file icon before the label; decorative

configOptions.options: All collapsed, Expanded to the current item

variants.caption: Multiple selection — checkboxes on each item

usageNotes: The ARIA tree role comes with a full keyboard model from the ARIA Authoring Practices: one tab stop, arrow keys to move and to expand or collapse, Home and End, and type-ahead. Use the role only if you build all of it.
For site navigation, use nested <ul> lists of links inside Navigation, with Disclosure buttons for sections. Links in a tree lose their normal tab and link behavior.
Set aria-expanded on parent items only; leaf items have no expanded state. Give the tree an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
For rows with several columns that can also expand, use a Data grid (the treegrid pattern) instead.
Don't rely on indentation alone to show nesting. Pair it with expand icons, and with indent guides when the tree is deep.
